mission: Ship a lending product people trust
declaration:
We lend to people the big banks ignore, and we stay in business by being
right about who to trust, not by charging for mistakes.

principles.title: Approve in minutes, not days
principles.description: A complete application gets a decision the same day. Waiting is a cost we put on the applicant, so we treat delay as a defect.

principles.title: Explain every rejection
principles.description: A rejected applicant is told which requirement was not met, in plain language, in the rejection message itself.

principles.title: Never lend what someone cannot repay
principles.description: Affordability is checked against verified income, not stated income.
